description: This walk takes you along the Stourbridge Canal and the Staffordshire and Worcestershire Canal from Stourbridge to Kinver. The route runs for around 5 miles, following the towpath north west to Wordsley Junction and Stourton Junction before finishing in Kinver.Along the way, you pass locks, bridges and historic canal features, with the River Stour running close to the route in places.The walk finishes in Kinver, a picturesque village on the River Stour with a good choice of pubs and cafes. The Kinver Edge countryside and the National Trust'sKinver Edgeand Rock Houses are also close by, making this a good area to explore before or after the walk.
